import struct

# Read the executable
with open('/app/vulnerable', 'rb') as f:
    data = f.read()

# Check for ELF header
if data[:4] != b'\x7fELF':
    print("Not an ELF file")
    exit(1)

# Parse ELF header (64-bit)
elf_header = struct.unpack('<16sHHIQQQIHHHHHH', data[:64])
e_phoff = elf_header[5]  # Program header offset
e_shoff = elf_header[6]  # Section header offset
e_phentsize = elf_header[10]  # Program header entry size
e_phnum = elf_header[11]  # Number of program headers
e_shentsize = elf_header[12]  # Section header entry size
e_shnum = elf_header[13]  # Number of section headers
e_shstrndx = elf_header[15]  # Section header string table index

print(f"ELF Header parsed:")
print(f"  Section header offset: {e_shoff}")
print(f"  Section header entry size: {e_shentsize}")
print(f"  Number of sections: {e_shnum}")

# Read section headers
sections = []
for i in range(e_shnum):
    offset = e_shoff + i * e_shentsize
    sh = struct.unpack('<IIQQQQIIQQ', data[offset:offset + e_shentsize])
    sections.append({
        'name_idx': sh[0],
        'type': sh[1],
        'flags': sh[2],
        'addr': sh[3],
        'offset': sh[4],
        'size': sh[5],
        'link': sh[6],
        'info': sh[7],
        'addralign': sh[8],
        'entsize': sh[9]
    })

# Read section header string table
shstrtab_section = sections[e_shstrndx]
shstrtab = data[shstrtab_section['offset']:shstrtab_section['offset'] + shstrtab_section['size']].split(b'\x00')

# Find .data section
for i, section in enumerate(sections):
    name = shstrtab[section['name_idx']].decode('ascii', errors='replace') if section['name_idx'] < len(shstrtab) else ''
    if name == '.data':
        print(f"\nFound .data section:")
        print(f"  Offset: {section['offset']}")
        print(f"  Size: {section['size']}")
        
        # Read and XOR decrypt .data section
        data_section = data[section['offset']:section['offset'] + section['size']]
        key = 0x42
        decrypted = bytes([b ^ key for b in data_section])
        
        print(f"\nDecrypted .data content:")
        print(decrypted.decode('latin-1'))
        
        # Look for FLAG pattern
        import re
        matches = re.findall(b'FLAG\{[^}]+\}', decrypted)
        for m in matches:
            print(f"\nFound flag: {m.decode('utf-8', errors='replace')}")
